name: Architecture Spec
summary: Creates an implementation-ready architecture, gap analysis, risk model, and recommended next steps.
guidance: Use when the first agent needs to design the solution, clarify boundaries, or map a major migration or feature before coding starts.

name: Repository Audit
summary: Audits the current state of the repository, identifies gaps, and creates a target map.
guidance: Use when the repo is only partially understood, the bundle was created off-repo, or current implementation claims need to be verified before planning.

name: Implementation Plan
summary: Converts an approved design or goal into milestones, files, tests, and acceptance checkpoints.
guidance: Use after architecture or audit work to prepare a deterministic plan that another agent can execute.

name: Feature Implementation
summary: Delivers a feature or enhancement in code with staged verification and handoff.
guidance: Use when the main requirement is to produce working code, tests, and artifacts rather than just planning.

name: Safe Refactor
summary: Improves structure while preserving behavior and locking regressions down.
guidance: Use when complexity or duplication is the main issue and behavior should stay stable.

name: Bugfix with Regression Lock
summary: Fixes a bug and leaves behind targeted regression proof.
guidance: Use when the agent must reproduce, fix, and lock down a concrete defect quickly without widening scope.

name: Senior Code Review
summary: Produces findings-first review output focused on behavior, risk, and missing evidence.
guidance: Use when a second-pass reviewer should challenge the design, change set, or validation claims.

name: Test Strategy and Automation
summary: Designs or expands the test matrix, automation approach, and evidence expectations.
guidance: Use when the session is about validation design, Playwright rollout, or closing coverage gaps.

name: Validation Audit
summary: Performs a final proof-oriented audit on architecture, testing, and residual risk.
guidance: Use when code or plans already exist and the main job is to validate, challenge, and close out honestly.

name: Performance Hardening
summary: Optimizes hot paths, runtime cost, or scheduling behavior with explicit proof.
guidance: Use when latency, browser performance, rendering cost, or embedded timing is part of the quality bar.

name: Security Hardening
summary: Focuses the session on threats, trust boundaries, secret handling, and hardening proof.
guidance: Use for auth, billing, secrets, client/server trust boundaries, or unsafe configuration changes.

name: UI/UX Delivery
summary: Designs and delivers user-facing flows with real interaction, accessibility, and browser proof.
guidance: Use when the prompt is centered on pages, components, canvas, or navigation flows.

name: Embedded Firmware Iteration
summary: Designs and delivers firmware or hardware-integrated changes with timing and hardware constraints visible.
guidance: Use when the work touches microcontrollers, sensors, MIDI, serial protocols, or host-side telemetry for hardware flows.
